title: Sprint 15 Planning and Client Prep
raw_text:
Sarah: Sprint 14 is done. Karim finished the ORM migration. Youssef has a working search prototype. Good work. Now, Sprint 15. The priority is the notification system. Lina, you have the requirements ready?

Lina: Yes, they have been ready for three weeks. The client demo is on May 1. We are already late.

Sarah: The demo was moved to May 15. I communicated that to sales.

Lina: Sales told me the demo is May 8. They never got a message about May 15.

Sarah: I will follow up with sales today. Regardless, we need notifications working by May 12 at the latest.

Karim: I can build the backend notification service. I estimate one week.

Youssef: I will build the frontend notification panel. I also need one week, but I depend on Karim's API.

Sarah: Karim, deliver the notification API by May 9. Youssef, you finish the frontend by May 12.

Omar: I need to set up the message queue for notifications. RabbitMQ or Redis pub/sub?

Sarah: Use Redis. It is simpler and we already have it running.

Omar: Fine. I will have Redis pub/sub configured by May 7.

Lina: One more thing. The budget review from last month said we keep both databases. Are we still doing that? Because the MongoDB cluster costs went up, not down.

Omar: I optimized it to 15,000 per month as planned. If it went up again, something else is running on that cluster.

Sarah: Omar, investigate the cost increase and report back by Wednesday. We are not making any database consolidation decisions this sprint.

Sarah: Clear plan everyone. Let us execute. Meeting adjourned.
